app.title: foldmap — Protein topology diagrams from structures
app.summary: A person types a structure identifier, picks an example or drops a structure file. The app works out the secondary structure and draws a 2D topology diagram of it straight away. They then refine the figure from a sidebar: theme, colouring and labels, which chains to show, and the layout itself through tables that swap, move, rename, mark, recolour or resize elements and define domains. They can also colour the figure with an alignment or their own per-residue values, or draw it like a reference structure to compare the two side by side or as a diff. They switch between the topology, sequence and 3D views and download the figure, its data, a reusable layout file and a share link.

task.text: Turn a molecular structure into a publication-ready 2D topology figure, adjusted by hand and optionally coloured by the person's own data or set against a reference structure.

data.text: One 3D molecular structure (atomic coordinates of protein and nucleic-acid chains), its sequence, and optional tables of per-residue values, crosslinks, a multiple sequence alignment and a second reference structure.
data.item: a secondary-structure element (a helix, strand or stem) of one structure, drawn on the figure

stage.text: making figures of a solved or predicted structure for a paper or talk, after the structure exists

mechanism.text: A start screen loads a structure and opens a workspace whose one large canvas shows the topology figure, the sequence figure or a linked 3D page, switched from the top bar. Every sidebar control (style, chains, layout editor tables, data uploads, reference structure) redraws the canvas, and the Download menu saves whatever the views last drew.

field.text: protein and nucleic-acid topology diagrams in structural biology

workflow.name: compute a figure from one item, then refine and export it

steps.here: Type a PDB ID or UniProt accession and press Draw, pick an example pill or drop a .cif/.pdb file. An accession lists its AlphaFold model and experimental structures in a table, and picking a row loads that one.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Loading assigns secondary structure, sheets, symmetry and assemblies and draws the topology figure at once with the current theme. A slow figure turns auto-redraw off and shows a Redraw button.
Theme (with a thumbnail browser), Colour by with its palette, toggles for labels, residue numbers and legend, text size, title, which chains and assembly to draw, and Reset to theme.

steps.step: select a stretch and label it with a category
steps.here: Edit layout tabs are tables of drawn elements: swap two, move by dx/dy, rename, mark or colour, set width, and name domains as residue ranges. There are also arrangement, rotation and element-size sliders.

Upload a multiple sequence alignment for conservation colouring, a table of per-residue values (choose the column), or crosslinks drawn as lines checked against their span. UniProt domains and sites can also be added.
Draw like… takes a reference by PDB ID or upload and shows this structure drawn in the reference's frame, a Compare page with both side by side, or a Diff page with displacement and domain turns.

The Download popover offers the figure as SVG, PNG or PDF, its data tables, the sequence figure, the 3D page, a layout file and a share link. A saved layout file can be loaded again to restore every setting.

distinctive: the figure is computed deterministically from 3D coordinates, so hand edits are kept as a reusable layout file of residue ranges rather than as positions
a readability floor (minimum text size) is checked on every figure, and the app suggests drawing one subunit or fewer chains when the figure falls below it
the same structure is shown in three linked forms (2D topology, annotated sequence, 3D page), switched in one canvas
a second structure can serve as a reference, so the figure is laid out in its frame or diffed against it
a hosted mode caps residues, time and memory and never opens server file paths, so share links carry only public ids
